title: BUG: declining the spend leaves the buffed unit exhausted (the option is auto-taken today)

repro.testName: BUG: declining the spend leaves the buffed unit exhausted (the option is auto-taken today)

history.note: same root cause as dad03a93c255: no prompt exists to decline, because effects/optional.ts auto-applies and the executor has no mid-sequence suspension/continuation (sequence.ts and for-each.ts never check draft.pendingChoice). Declining cannot be expressed without a new pending-choice + continuation capability.
